quest.title: The Gourmet Supremos: Breakthrough Thinking
quest.description: Xudong, the leader of the Gourmet Supremos, seems to be troubled by a certain matter...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Hey, Traveler. Nice to see you again.

choices.text: Anything that I can help you with?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Remember how I promised you a meal? I'm making preparations for it right now.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: We've been collecting fresh ingredients from everywhere to make a great meal.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: I've almost got enough ingredients, so I'm trying to figure out how to cook them.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Where are Julie and Parvaneh?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Well, Parvaneh is out tracking down more ingredients for the "ultimate seasoning" that she wanted to make.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: She took Julie outdoors with her on that search... They said they wouldn't go too far from town, though, so don't worry.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: However, I do need your help with something. Although I have a lot of fresh ingredients, I don't have... the inspiration I need to make a breakthrough.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Look at these. Seagrass... Sea Ganoderma, and... uh, Sakura Bloom...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: They are quite fresh, but I have no idea where to start.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: I was going to ask a local chef in Inazuma for advice. But if I did that, I'd end up with the usual Inazuma cuisine. It's nothing new.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: So I thought of using Inazuman ingredients like the chefs from Liyue. That way, I might be able to make something new and exciting.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Traveler, could you please go to Liyue and consult Chef Mao of the Wanmin Restaurant for me?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Thanks. I'll be waiting for you here.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: I hope Chef Mao has some good ideas...

choices.text: You want that bit of boom shaka-laka, don't you?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Boom shaka-laka? What? Do you mean... a kind of feeling of awe from food?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: If you can find a recipe with that feeling, that would be fantastic.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: But I don't know anyone who would have such a recipe...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Anyway, please go and consult Chef Mao for me first.

choices.text: Are you going to treat me to that meal?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Hahaha, that's exactly what I'm prepping for!

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Huh? Traveler, what are you doing here? Want me to whip something tasty up again?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm actually here for your advice...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Xudong went to Inazuma to cook?... He really has quite a bit of determination.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you know him?

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Sort of. We had a cooking rivalry once, and it was... a stalemate.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: He said he wanted to travel the world looking for a breakthrough... I never thought he would actually do it.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Still, it looks like he's hit a wall...

choices.text: Do you know what might help him?

response.speaker: Chef Mao
response.text: I can't guarantee it will work, but I'll try my best.

response.speaker: Chef Mao
response.text: Seagrass... Sea Ganoderma... and... Sakura Bloom? These are strange ingredients...

response.speaker: Chef Mao
response.text: If I took the Seagrass and Sea Ganoderma alone, I think I could make a dish... but we'll need some additional things.

response.speaker: Chef Mao
response.text: Traveler, could you please go and find some Jueyun Chili and Fowl for me?

response.speaker: Chef Mao
response.text: Thanks. Bring them to me once you get them.

response.speaker: Chef Mao
response.text: Hahaha, that's for sure. They are the hardest to mess up too. Bring them to me once you get some.

response.speaker: Chef Mao
response.text: That said, I really don't know how to cook Sakura Blooms... I'm not sure how chefs in Inazuma handle them.

choices.text: Perhaps Xiangling knows how to solve his problem...

response.speaker: Chef Mao
response.text: Xiangling... True, she's always been a very creative cook. Maybe she can figure out a solution.

response.speaker: Chef Mao
response.text: But she's gone to Qingce Village to pick bamboo shoots at the moment, so she isn't here. It'll take a while to find her.

response.speaker: Chef Mao
response.text: Xudong must be waiting anxiously. Let me see if I can solve his problem.

talks.objective: Give the Jueyun Chili and Fowl to Chef Mao

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Have you gotten the Jueyun Chili and Fowl?

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: That should be enough. Hold on a moment. I'll see what I can do with these ingredients...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Done. Still, I feel like it's not all that different from the dishes I usually make...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Take this dish back to Xudong. Hopefully, it'll solve his problem...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: These bamboo shoots look pretty good. I'll dig some up...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Huh? It's you. What brings you here? Want me to whip something tasty up again?

choices.text: Well, I've got something I need your help with.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Oh. Handling ingredients from Inazuma using techniques from Liyue...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Hehe. You've come to the right chef! I've heard of an Inazuman technique where you wrap ingredients in flour and fry them.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: It's called tempura and it's served with a special dipping sauce.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I was particularly interested in the dipping sauce when I tried making tempura.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I've tried so many ingredients: Whopperflower Nectar, Flaming Flower...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is it made with Slime Condensate, by any chance?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: No, no. Slime Condensate isn't appropriate for this dish.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Still, I prefer adding the powder from Electro Cicin wings to give it a more layered texture.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Just in case you forget, I'll write it down. Then you can show it to Xudong.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: *sigh* I wish I could go to Inazuma. There must be so many ingredients I haven't used yet.

choices.text: You reacted just like Chef Mao...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Oh, you went to the restaurant? Hmm. But now that I've had another look, you don't look like you're here for a meal.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Are you having some culinary problems, then?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Oh, you're back. What did Chef Mao say?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: This dish... let me give it a try...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: The taste is great and the combination of the ingredients is also really good. As expected of Chef Mao.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: However, I still feel like it's missing a little something...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The boom shaka-laka feeling, I suppose.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: I don't know... *sigh* I'll think about it. At least Chef Mao has given me an idea.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Thank you for your help. Please take these.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: How on earth am I going to make a truly unique dish...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Xiangling... wrote this? It must have been hard to find her. Thank you for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Let's see... Whopperflower Nectar... Flaming Flower... and Electro Cicin wing powder...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Rather... unexpected, I must say.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: I'll look into this... In the meantime, please take these as thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Ahem... I better read these notes and put them away quickly. I can't let Parvaneh find them...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Oh, you're back. What did Chef Mao say?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: I sure hope Chef Mao has some good ideas...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wanmin Restaurant... Paimon remembers that name. That's the restaurant Xiangling and her father run, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It would be great if we could ask Xiangling for advice. She's really good at cooking.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who knows, we might even get something that's got that boom shaka-laka!
